ValidationRule.description: Following dates cannot be changed once it is set: - Coupon Issued Date - Coupon Distributed Date - Coupon Issued but Voided Date - Coupon Unissued but Voided Date - Coupon Used Date - Coupon Voided Date
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR ( ( ISPICKVAL( Coupon_Status__c, "Distributed") && NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Coupon_Distributed_Date__c))) && ( ISCHANGED( Coupon_Distributed_Date__c ) || ISCHANGED( Distribution_Department__c ) ) ), ( ISPICKVAL( Coupon_Status__c, "Issued") && NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Coupon_Issued_Date__c))) && ISCHANGED( Coupon_Issued_Date__c ) ), ( ISPICKVAL( Coupon_Status__c, "Issued but Voided") && NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Coupon_Issued_but_Voided_Date__c ))) && ISCHANGED( Coupon_Issued_but_Voided_Date__c ) ), ( ISPICKVAL( Coupon_Status__c, "Unissued but Voided") && NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Coupon_Unissued_but_Voided_Date__c ))) && ISCHANGED( Coupon_Unissued_but_Voided_Date__c ) ), ( ISPICKVAL( Coupon_Status__c, "Used") && NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Coupon_Used_Date__c))) && ( ISCHANGED( Coupon_Used_Date__c ) || ISCHANGED( Coupon_Used_On__c ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Status date and the related fields(Distributed Department, Coupon Used On) cannot be modified once it is set.
